segs.en: H. Hurricane Signal

zh.ai: H. 飓风信号

segs.en: The Heung Shing Observatory has recently discovered a new hurricane approaching Heung Shing!

zh.ai: 兴盛气象台最近发现，一场新的飓风正逼近兴盛！

segs.en: The world can be viewed as an infinite 2D Cartesian plane, and Heung Shing is located at coordinates $$$(H_x, H_y)$$$. The hurricane is currently located at coordinates $$$(C_x, C_y)$$$. It is predicted to move along a straight line that forms an angle of $$$D$$$ degrees counterclockwise with the positive x-axis, however, the angle formed by the actual trajectory may be different due to a multitude of factors – it can be any real value between $$$D - U$$$ and $$$D + U$$$ degrees with uniform probability. When the hurricane comes within a 1 unit radius (inclusive) of Heung Shing, measured in Euclidean distance, a Hurricane Signal is issued.

zh.ai: 世界可以看作一个无限的二维笛卡尔平面，Heung Shing 位于坐标 $$$(H_x, H_y)$$$。飓风当前位于坐标 $$$(C_x, C_y)$$$。预计它将沿一条与 x 轴正方向逆时针形成 $$$D$$$ 度角的直线移动；然而，由于诸多因素的影响，实际轨迹形成的角度可能有所不同——它可以是 $$$D - U$$$ 到 $$$D + U$$$ 度之间的任意实数，且服从均匀分布。当飓风与 Heung Shing 之间的欧几里得距离小于等于 1 个单位时，将发布飓风信号。

segs.en: Consider the two sample scenarios shown in Figures 1 and 2. In both figures, Heung Shing is at point $$$H$$$ and the hurricane is currently at point $$$C$$$. The predicted trajectory of the hurricane is indicated by the green arrow. The actual trajectory of the hurricane must be within the sector formed by the red lines.

zh.ai: 考虑图 1 和图 2 所示的两个示例场景。在两幅图中，Heung Shing 位于点 $$$H$$$，飓风当前位于点 $$$C$$$。飓风的预测轨迹由绿色箭头表示。飓风的实际轨迹必须位于由红线形成的扇形区域内。

segs.en: A Hurricane Signal is issued when the hurricane enters the blue circle. In Figure 1, the Hurricane Signal may or may not be issued in the future depending on its actual trajectory. In Figure 2, the Hurricane Signal is never issued.

zh.ai: 当飓风进入蓝色圆圈时，将发布飓风信号。在图 1 中，未来是否发布飓风信号取决于飓风的实际轨迹，可能发布，也可能不发布。在图 2 中，永远不会发布飓风信号。

segs.en: Charlie is now interested in finding the probability that the hurricane will trigger a Hurricane Signal, either at its current position or somewhere along its future trajectory. Help Charlie find the answer!

zh.ai: Charlie 现在想知道飓风将在当前位置或未来轨迹上的某处触发飓风警报的概率。请帮助 Charlie 找到答案！

segs.en: The first line consists of two integers $$$H_x$$$ and $$$H_y$$$ $$$(-1000 \leq H_x, H_y \leq 1000)$$$, the coordinates of Heung Shing.

zh.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 $$$H_x$$$ 和 $$$H_y$$$ $$$(-1000 \leq H_x, H_y \leq 1000)$$$，表示 Heung Shing 的坐标。

segs.en: The second line consists of two integers $$$C_x$$$ and $$$C_y$$$ $$$(-1000 \leq C_x, C_y \leq 1000)$$$, the coordinates of the current position of the hurricane.

zh.ai: 第二行包含两个整数 $$$C_x$$$ 和 $$$C_y$$$ $$$(-1000 \leq C_x, C_y \leq 1000)$$$，表示飓风当前位置的坐标。

segs.en: The third line consists of an integer $$$D$$$ $$$(0 \leq D  \lt  360)$$$ and an integer $$$U$$$ $$$(0  \lt  U  \lt  90)$$$, the angle (in degrees, counterclockwise) formed by the predicted trajectory and the positive x-axis, and the maximum deviation (in degrees) of the prediction.

zh.ai: 第三行包含一个整数 $$$D$$$ $$$(0 \leq D  \lt  360)$$$ 和一个整数 $$$U$$$ $$$(0  \lt  U  \lt  90)$$$，分别表示预测轨迹与 x 轴正方向形成的角度(以度为单位，逆时针方向)以及预测结果的最大偏差(以度为单位)。

segs.en: Output a decimal number, the probability of a Hurricane Signal being issued. Your answer is considered correct if the absolute or relative error does not exceed $$$10^{-6}$$$.

zh.ai: 输出一个十进制数，表示发布飓风警报的概率。当绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $$$10^{-6}$$$ 时，答案将被视为正确。

segs.en: Formally, let your answer be $$$x$$$ and the correct answer be $$$y$$$. Your answer is accepted if and only if $$$\frac{|x-y|}{\max(1,|y|)} \leq 10^{-6}$$$.

zh.ai: 形式化地，设你的答案为 $$$x$$$，正确答案为 $$$y$$$。当且仅当 $$$\frac{|x-y|}{\max(1,|y|)} \leq 10^{-6}$$$ 时，你的答案才会被接受。

segs.en: See Figure 1 for an illustration of the first sample. The angle of the hurricane's path relative to the positive x-axis can be any value between $$$-30^\circ$$$ and $$$120^\circ$$$ with uniform probability. Heung Shing will issue the Hurricane Signal if this angle is between $$$0^\circ$$$ and $$$90^\circ$$$. Therefore the required probability is $$$\frac{90}{150} = 0.6$$$.

zh.ai: 第一组样例的示意图见图 1。飓风路径相对于 x 轴正方向的角度可以在 $$$-30^\circ$$$ 和 $$$120^\circ$$$ 之间以均匀概率取任意值。当该角度位于 $$$0^\circ$$$ 和 $$$90^\circ$$$ 之间时，Heung Shing 将发布飓风信号。因此所求概率为 $$$\frac{90}{150} = 0.6$$$。

segs.en: See Figure 2 for an illustration of the second sample. The angle of the hurricane's path relative to the positive x-axis can be any value between $$$195^\circ$$$ and $$$225^\circ$$$ with equal probability. The hurricane will always be more than 1 unit away from Heung Shing.

zh.ai: 第二个样例的示意图见图 2。飓风路径相对于 x 轴正方向的角度可以在 $$$195^\circ$$$ 到 $$$225^\circ$$$ 之间取任意值，且取到每个值的概率相同。飓风与 Heung Shing 之间的距离始终大于 1。

segs.en: M. MEX Queries

zh.ai: M. MEX 询问

segs.en: This is an interactive problem.

zh.ai: 这是一道交互题。

segs.en: There is a hidden array $$$a$$$ of size $$$n$$$.

zh.ai: 有一个大小为 $$$n$$$ 的隐藏数组 $$$a$$$。

segs.en: You can make queries of the following form:

zh.ai: 你可以进行如下形式的询问：

segs.en: Provide a subset $$$P \subseteq \{1, 2, ..., n\}$$$ and a subset $$$Q \subseteq \{0, 1, 2, ..., n\}$$$.

zh.ai: 给出一个子集 $$$P \subseteq \{1, 2, ..., n\}$$$ 和一个子集 $$$Q \subseteq \{0, 1, 2, ..., n\}$$$。

segs.en: The interactor will construct a set $$$S = \{a_{p_i} \mid p_i \in P\} \cup Q$$$. It will calculate and give you the MEX$$$^†$$$ of the set $$$S$$$.

zh.ai: 交互器将构造一个集合 $$$S = \{a_{p_i} \mid p_i \in P\} \cup Q$$$。它将计算并给出集合 $$$S$$$ 的 MEX$$$^†$$$。

segs.en: Using at most $$$15 n$$$ queries, find the hidden array $$$a$$$ and output it.

zh.ai: 使用不超过 $$$15 n$$$ 次查询，找出隐藏数组 $$$a$$$ 并输出它。

segs.en: $$$^†$$$The MEX of a set is the smallest non-negative integer that is not present in the set. For example, MEX($$$\{0, 1, 4, 5\}$$$) is $$$2$$$ and MEX($$$\{45\}$$$) is $$$0$$$.
Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 100$$$). The description of the test cases follows.

zh.ai: 每组测试包含多个测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的数量 $$$t$$$($$$1 \le t \le 100$$$)。下面给出各测试用例的描述。

segs.en: The only line of each test case contains a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 400$$$) — the size of the hidden array $$$a$$$ (although they will not be provided in the input, the elements of $$$a$$$ satisfy $$$0 \le a_i \le n$$$).

zh.ai: 每个测试用例仅包含一行，其中有一个整数 $$$n$$$($$$1 \le n \le 400$$$)——隐藏数组 $$$a$$$ 的大小(尽管它们不会在输入中给出，但 $$$a$$$ 的元素满足 $$$0 \le a_i \le n$$$)。

segs.en: It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases is at most $$$400$$$.

zh.ai: 保证所有测试用例中 $$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 $$$400$$$。

segs.en: You can make queries in the following format — to query subsets $$$P$$$ and $$$Q$$$, output one line of the form "? $$$x$$$ $$$y$$$" (where $$$x = |P|$$$ and $$$y = |Q|$$$). On the next line, output $$$x$$$ unique space-separated integers — the elements of $$$P$$$. On the next line, output $$$y$$$ unique space-separated integers — the elements of $$$Q$$$. After that, read a single integer — the value of MEX of $$$S$$$ (which is constructed as described above).

zh.ai: 你可以按照以下格式进行询问——若要询问子集 $$$P$$$ 和 $$$Q$$$，输出一行，格式为“? $$$x$$$ $$$y$$$”(其中 $$$x = |P|$$$ 且 $$$y = |Q|$$$)。下一行输出 $$$x$$$ 个互不相同、以空格分隔的整数，即 $$$P$$$ 的元素。再下一行输出 $$$y$$$ 个互不相同、以空格分隔的整数，即 $$$Q$$$ 的元素。之后，读取一个整数——$$$S$$$ 的 MEX 值(该集合按照上述方式构造)。

segs.en: To report the hidden array as $$$b$$$, output "! $$$b_1$$$ $$$b_2$$$ ... $$$b_n$$$". Then, the interaction continues with the next test case.

zh.ai: 要将隐藏数组报告为 $$$b$$$，请输出“! $$$b_1$$$ $$$b_2$$$ ... $$$b_n$$$”。随后，交互将继续进行下一个测试用例。

segs.en: Reporting the answer does not count towards the number of queries made.

zh.ai: 报告答案不计入查询次数。

segs.en: Note that you have to use the flush operation right after printing each line — otherwise you may get Idleness Limit Exceeded verdict. For example, in C++ you should use the function fflush(stdout) or cout.flush(), in Java or Kotlin — System.out.flush(), and in Python — sys.stdout.flush().

zh.ai: 注意，在输出每一行后，你必须立即执行刷新操作，否则可能会得到超时（Idleness Limit Exceeded）判定。例如，在 C++ 中应使用函数 fflush(stdout) 或 cout.flush()；在 Java 或 Kotlin 中使用 System.out.flush()；在 Python 中使用 sys.stdout.flush()。

segs.en: You do not have to handle comments (lines starting with #) in the input; they are only for presentation purposes and will not be present in the test cases.

zh.ai: 无需处理输入中的注释（以 # 开头的行）；它们仅用于展示，不会出现在测试数据中。

segs.en: The queries given in the sample input and output are for demonstrating the interaction, and may not logically lead to a correct output.

zh.ai: 样例输入和输出中的查询仅用于演示交互过程，逻辑上可能无法得到正确的输出。

segs.en:
Test case 1: The hidden array is $$$[0]$$$.The participant's code makes one query, with $$$P = \{1\}$$$ and $$$Q = \{\}$$$. The interactor calculates $$$S = \{0\}$$$ and returns its MEX, $$$1$$$.
The participant's code correctly concludes that the hidden array is $$$[0]$$$ and outputs it.

zh.ai:
测试用例 1：隐藏数组为 $$$[0]$$$。参赛者的代码进行了一次询问，参数为 $$$P = \{1\}$$$ 和 $$$Q = \{\}$$$。交互器计算 $$$S = \{0\}$$$，并返回其 MEX 值 $$$1$$$。
参赛者的代码正确地推断出隐藏数组为 $$$[0]$$$，并将其输出。

segs.en:
Test case 2: The hidden array is $$$[3, 1, 4, 2, 5, 0]$$$.The participant's code makes the first query query, with $$$P = \{2, 6, 4\}$$$ and $$$Q = \{0\}$$$. The interactor calculates $$$S = \{1, 0, 2\}$$$ and returns its MEX, $$$3$$$.
The participant's code makes the second query, with $$$P = \{5, 3, 1\}$$$ and $$$Q = \{4, 5, 6\}$$$. The interactor calculates $$$S = \{5, 4, 3, 6\}$$$ and returns its MEX, $$$0$$$.
The participant's code correctly concludes that the hidden array is $$$[3, 1, 4, 2, 5, 0]$$$ and outputs it.
